typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	appDmwebDb as string (),
	appDmwebPassword as string (),
	appDmwebSource as string (),
	appDmwebUser as string (),
	archiveFileNameWithPath as string (),
	archivePath as string (),
	env as string (),
	errorDesc as string (),
	fileDefId as integer (),
	fileDefObj as string (),
	fileFormatConfigId as integer (),
	fileId as integer (),
	fileNameWithPath as string (),
	fileObj as string (),
	filePattern as string (),
	fileStatusConfigId as integer (),
	importLineOrdinal as integer (),
	importPath as string (),
	origFileNameWithPath as string (),
	profileConfigId as integer (),
	storedProc as string (),
	tidalJobNo as string (),
	unstableCheckTime as integer ()
}

source(output(
		importLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(fileId = $fileId,
		importLine = toString(substring(toString(importLine), toInteger(1), toInteger(8000)))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(fileId = fileId) ~> PlaceHolderCGetImportLineOrdinal
PlaceHolderCGetImportLineOrdinal sink(input(
		importLine as string,
		fileId as integer,
		ordinal as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		importLine,
		fileId,
		ordinal = importLineOrdinal)) ~> OLEDBDestination
